description_en: Deploys a policy instance in a specified namespace of a specified cluster. You can select a security policy type in an ACK cluster, configure the governance action (alerting or blocking) and the namespace scope for the policy instance to create and deploy a policy instance
description_zh: 您可以在ACK集群中选择安全策略类型，配置策略实例的治理动作（告警或拦截）、作用的命名空间范围等，以创建并部署一个策略实例。您可以调用DeployPolicyInstance接口，在指定集群的命名空间中部署策略规则实例
kebab_example: aliyun cs deploy-policy-instance --cluster-id c8155823d057948c69a0000 --policy-name ACKAllowedRepos --action deny --namespaces default --parameters repos=["registry-vpc.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/acs/","registry.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/acs/"] --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeployPolicyInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target cluster
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the policy governance rule
parameters.name: policy_name

parameters.help_en:
The governance action of the rule. Valid values:

- `deny`: blocks non-compliant deployments.
- `warn`: generates alerts
parameters.help_zh:
规则治理动作，取值：

- `deny`：拦截违规部署
- `warn`：告警
parameters.name: action

parameters.help_en: The namespaces to which the policy is restricted. An empty value indicates all namespaces
parameters.help_zh: 限制策略实施的命名空间，为空时表示所有命名空间
parameters.name: namespaces

parameters.help_en: The parameter settings of the current rule instance. For the parameters supported by each policy governance rule and the corresponding metric description, see [Security policy rule library](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/doc-detail/359819.html)
parameters.help_zh: 当前规则实例的参数配置。每个策略治理规则支持的参数以及对应的参数说明，详见 [容器安全策略规则库说明](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/doc-detail/359819.html)
parameters.name: parameters
